about.title: Your health journey, in safe hands
about.heroSub: A platform connecting international patients with trusted health resorts and sanatoriums across the region.
about.whatWeDoP1: HealthVoyage helps patients find the right place for treatment and recovery abroad — from Naftalan oil therapy and thermal balneology to rehabilitation and specialised sanatorium programs. We bring resorts from several countries into one catalog so you can compare by destination, treatment profile and more.
about.whatWeDoP2: We specialise in balneological and sanatorium care across Azerbaijan, Georgia, Belarus, Lithuania, Hungary, Russia and Serbia — regions with a long tradition of mineral-water, mud and climate therapies, alongside modern medical and rehabilitation centers.

about.value4d: We work directly with resorts to confirm what they offer.
